blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawmakers on Monday said plenary discussions on proposed amendments to the P7.2-trillion 2027 budget will be open to the public. The Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee will soon convene to hammer out proposed tweaks to House Bill No. 10858.
